verdict.rationale: The Texas Secretary of State runs online filing services that hold user-submitted data, so whether that data is shielded from AI training is a fair privacy question. The evidence offers no documented user-facing AI-training opt-out or no-training policy. The only related item is a robots.txt crawler ban on the filing host, which is an adjacent site-level control, not a user capability to keep their own data out of training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
